scope: Record reign-persistent progression directly supported by the September 27 Hatchery reward screens and the detailed Dragon Pit habit screens. Star ranks are updated only when directly supported by a Star Up label or an unambiguous post-reward star row; habit levels are updated only when directly displayed in the Dragon Pit.

verified_progression_changes.name: Nyrena
verified_progression_changes.evidence: IMG_5219 shows 'Star Up!' above Nyrena; IMG_5220/IMG_5221 show the same reward batch and a five-star post-reward row.

verified_progression_changes.name: Starshower
verified_progression_changes.evidence: IMG_5221 shows Starshower with two filled stars after the x1 award. The prior verified September 20 profile was 1 star at 38/40, and September 26 recorded a further x1 award.

verified_progression_changes.name: Seasmoke
verified_progression_changes.evidence: IMG_5222/IMG_5223 show 'Star Up!' above Seasmoke and a two-star post-reward row. The September 20 baseline was 1 star at 35/40, so the x5 award exactly reaches the star-up threshold.

verified_progression_changes.name: Kalspire
verified_progression_changes.evidence: IMG_5222/IMG_5223 show 'Star Up!' above Kalspire and a two-star post-reward row. The September 20 baseline was 1 star at 30/40, so the x10 award exactly reaches the star-up threshold.

verified_progression_changes.name: Caraxes
verified_progression_changes.evidence: IMG_5234.jpeg shows 'Star Up!' above Caraxes, two filled stars, and an exact post-up relic counter of 0/100.

verification_notes: Nyrena's five-star rank is directly verified. Do not infer any newly available or upgraded habit until a detailed Dragon Pit profile is captured.
Starshower's two-star rank is directly verified by the post-reward star row. Do not infer a habit unlock or level from the star increase.

The same screenshots also show star rows consistent with the previously verified states for Dawnseeker 4 stars, Shimmer 6 stars, Jagadrix 6 stars, Antares 4 stars, Arrax 4 stars, Bevlorin 5 stars, Arulix 5 stars, Syrax 2 stars, Zivern 6 stars, and Vaeldra 4 stars.
Exact current relic totals for the other reward recipients are not reconstructed because intervening progress is not guaranteed to be fully enumerated by the dated overlays.
Gold, keys, and the next-pull price shown on the reward screen are retained only in the dated Hatchery log, not this persistent progression overlay.
A second September 27 Standard Hatchery batch is recorded from IMG_5222 through IMG_5225: 70 visible relics across 17 dragons.

Seasmoke and Kalspire are directly verified at 2 stars by 'Star Up!' labels and two-star post-reward rows. Their September 20 exact baselines were 35/40 and 30/40 respectively, matching the x5 and x10 awards needed to reach 2 stars.
No habit unlocks or habit levels are inferred for Seasmoke or Kalspire from their new star ranks.
Across both September 27 reward batches, 235 visible relics are recorded across 20 unique dragons.
The September 20 ten-march plan remains stale for optimization; it now also predates Nyrena 5★, Starshower 2★, Seasmoke 2★, and Kalspire 2★.

Detailed Dragon Pit screens supplied later on September 27 directly verify current habit levels for Arrax (Headlong Into Danger 3), Zivern (Fearsome Reach 2), Jagadrix (Whispering Sabotage 5), Vaeldra (Dragon's Valor 3), Arulix (Hypnotic Helix 4), and Thunderstrike (Dragon's Might 2).
Jagadrix's Whispering Sabotage is explicitly at max level 5.
Full displayed level tables and next-upgrade costs are stored in player-state/habit-update-2026-09-27.json.
Two later September 27 single-open result screens are recorded as third and fourth observed reward groups: IMG_5234.jpeg contributes 11 visible relics and IMG_5235.jpeg contributes 7.
Caraxes is directly verified at 2 stars by the 'Star Up!' label in IMG_5234.jpeg; the same screen shows an exact post-up relic counter of 0/100.
The cumulative Dawnseeker cards show 159/300 after x5, 160/300 after the following x1, and IMG_5235.jpeg then shows 161/300 after another x1.
IMG_5235.jpeg directly shows Thunderstrike at 244/300 and Smoketail at 57/100; these exact counters supersede older non-exact reward-only progress for those dragons.
No habit unlock or habit level is inferred for Caraxes from reaching 2 stars.
